queueView.heading: Import documents
queueView.intro: Upload several old Word or PDF minutes at once — even bundled as a ZIP, in which case only the Word and PDF files inside are imported, everything else is ignored. The files are assigned to the same template, analyzed immediately and land as "Read" in the table below.
queueView.pageIntro: Collect, review and import old .docx minutes — every confirmed import automatically re-analyzes the remaining, still open documents in the queue to improve their suggestions. Manual corrections already made to those documents are preserved.
